chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Aṣbagh, from some of our companions, who said:
I saw Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام while he was at a جنازة, and he cast earth upon the grave with the backs of his two hands.

key_terms.التُّرَابَ: earth or soil cast onto the grave
key_terms.جِنَازَةٍ: a funeral procession or funeral setting

ai.seo_question: How did Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام place earth on a grave during a funeral?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an observed practice of Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام during a funeral. It describes how he placed earth upon the grave, preserving a detail relevant to funerary conduct and transmitted practice.
